subject: Re: Numbers on our exec dashboard look old
body: It's the Snowflake connector, the one called prod-warehouse. The freshness badge says 14 hours. There's nothing on the Activity tab about a backfill.
history: CUSTOMER: Our exec dashboard is showing figures that don't match the warehouse. Can you tell me why it's behind?

AGENT: Dashboards show a freshness badge with the timestamp of the last completed sync for the underlying tables, and on the Team plan connectors sync at most every 6 hours. So which connector is behind, and what does its freshness badge say? You can find both on Data > Connectors > (connector) > Activity.
